sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam.

Debrief completed; suiting up for deployment and patrols.
Commencing Alpha Route. Check-in at corner of Victoria Street East and Queen Street; streets very quiet.

Tony's Original Steakhouse and Seafood Restaurant
Check-in at Skyworld Entertainment Centre, all clear.
Ending Alpha Route and commencing Delta Route.
Welfare check at Jack's Fried Chicken, Jack's Cafeteria, The Terrace, Aotea Centre, Cafe and Bar, all clear.
Check-in at Auckland Town Hall, all clear.
Queens Food Court and all restaurants within the vicinity
Tanuki Japanese Sake and Sushi Bar
Check-in at corner of Rutland Street and Wakefield Street, all clear.
Welfare check at Bentto, Choice Plaza, Sushiya, Choice Backpackers, Little Hanoi, Little Panda Takeaway Wellesley Street East, all clear.
Check-in at corner of Wellesley Street East and Lorne Street, all clear.
Response call regarding a disturbed, aggressive male individual in the bottom-of-Queen-Street area; assistance requested to speak with him and see if he needs assistance.
Arrived at the response call area; scanning for the reported individual.
Response call from Lance and Hasi regarding a female individual undressed in front of the Titanic: The Human Story site; directed to intercept.
Arrived at the response call and spoke to the female individual — a known thief and repeat offender at many stores in the CBD.
Kindly asked her to cover up due to public indecency, with families and children around; she appeared to be wearing only a bra and very short pants.
The individual complied, got up and left heading towards Aotea Square.
Resuming Delta Route; cutting through to Lorne Street.

Welfare check on stores along lower High Street towards Shortland Street, all clear:
Welfare check at Shortland Street Convenience Store, Taco Bell, North Face, Haven Mart, UGG Shoes, Hoka, all clear.
Check-in at corner of Fort Street and Fort Lane, all clear.
Welfare check along Fort Lane, all clear:
Call from management requesting we return to Headquarters and tag them through to Level 7.
Arrived back at Headquarters and tagged management up to Level 7.
Returned to Level 1; took a photo of the timesheets and sent it through to Gina.
Standing by while Guard Two uses the restroom due to an ongoing stomach ache; remaining vigilant and awaiting response calls.
Leaving standby; resuming patrols and routes.
Patrolling the Queen Street strip towards lower Queen Street.
Check-in at Commercial Bay, all clear. Ending Delta Route and commencing Echo Route.
Check-in at Queens Arcade, all clear.
Check-in at corner of Shortland Street and Queen Street, all clear.
Check-in at corner of Federal Street and Victoria Street West, all clear.
Welfare check at 77 Convenience Store, Eighty Fed, all clear.
Standing by to show presence to the public; busy foot traffic due to the public holiday.
Lunch break completed; standing by for changeover to the Afternoon Shift.
Changeover to the Afternoon Shift completed.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 2 x Radio, 1 x Bodycam, 1 x Swipe Key.
Debrief with Morning Shift regarding morning status, incidents and response calls.
Debrief completed; suiting up for deployment and patrols.
Check-in at corner of Darby Street and Queen Street, all clear.
Standing by to show presence on the Queen Street strip due to busy foot traffic — most calls come from this area (14:45–15:00).
Welfare check at the Wilson Carpark food stalls, all clear.
Welfare check and sweep through Wilson Carpark Elliott Street, all clear.
Crossing into Albert Street; welfare check at Peppers Cafe, City Convenience Store, all clear.
Walkthrough of the casino escalators through to Federal Street.
Welfare check at Sky City Grand Hotel, The Fed, Eighty Fed, 77 Convenience Store, all clear.
Check-in at corner of Federal Street and Victoria Street West, all clear.
Welfare check at Vphix Mobiles, Izmir Kebab and Grill, Little Tiger Dumpling, 1947 Eatery, Kiwi Souvenirs, all clear.
Welfare check at People's Barista, all clear.
Standing by at corner of Vulcan Lane and Queen Street to show presence.
Check-in at corner of Shortland Street and Queen Street, all clear.
Check-in at Queens Arcade, all clear.
Ending Echo Route; standing by to show presence.
Response call from Hallensteins Queen Street regarding a male individual inside the fitting rooms suspected of stealing; assistance requested to deal with the individual.
Arrived at the response call and waited for the individual to exit the fitting rooms.
Individual exited the fitting room; we asked him to surrender the items stuffed inside his bag and he emptied it out — items worth $320 in total.
Individual surrendered the items and exited the premises.
Keeping an eye on the individual, seen heading up Queen Street; standing by in case he attempts theft at another store on upper Queen Street.
Individual sighted scanning stores along Queen Street.
Tailing the individual in case he enters one of the stores and steals.
Standing by on Queen Street to show presence (16:27–16:30).
After tracking the individual, he was seen heading away from the strip.
Standing by at lower Queen Street.
Commencing Alpha Route. Check-in at Commercial Bay, all clear.
Welfare check on stores along Queen Street towards upper Queen Street, all clear:
Welfare check and sweep through Imperial Lane, all clear.
Response call from the bottom of Queen Street regarding an aggressive individual; assistance requested.
Arrived at the response call near Imperial Lane; reports that the female had headed towards Britomart.
Tracking the female through Commercial Bay and the Britomart train station area.
Scanned the area; the female was last seen heading towards the train platform and onto one of the trains.
Female described as wearing all black with a hat and glasses, showing signs of being under the influence of narcotics.
Standing by to show presence at Commercial Bay square in case the female doubles back (17:25–17:35).
Welfare check at McDonald's Britomart, all clear.
Welfare check and walkthrough of Wheirko Lane, Commercial Bay, all clear.
Welfare check at Aotea Gifts, Woolworths Lower Albert Street, all clear.
Welfare check at Rodd & Gunn, Dos Donkey, Burger Burger, Queens Rooftop Bar and Wineshop, all clear.
Standing by to show presence before moving towards Headquarters.
Leaving standby and heading towards Headquarters.
Arrived back at Headquarters; Guard Two spotted a suspicious individual entering Cotton On.
Standing by outside awaiting a possible response call from inside Cotton On regarding the male individual.
Individual exited the store; nothing wrong.
Heading to Headquarters to commence the mandatory building sweep.
Mandatory building patrols complete; heading back out on patrol.
Most stores now closed for trading hours apart from a few.
Noticed an argument at 77 Convenience Store between a customer and staff regarding a suspected fake dollar note.
Intervened and examined the note together with the store owner; identified a misunderstanding between them — matter resolved and the items were purchased.
While standing by, noticed street people arguing with each other and threatening to hit each other near Darby Street.
Intervened and worked to calm them down — an argument between Junior, Motu and Desiree.
Continuing to separate the parties; ongoing verbal exchanges and arguments.
Both parties still arguing; standing by until they part ways and the situation is neutralised (19:00–19:09).
Leaving standby and commencing patrols again.
Junior returned, frustrated and verbally going off at the other group with Motu and Desiree.
Calmed Junior down; he said he felt they were bullying him — we advised him to ignore the comments as they only have power if he reacts. He understood and calmed down.
Heading back to Headquarters to charge the Ops Phone, sitting at 11% (shown on camera).
During standby, response call from McDonald's regarding a trespassed individual inside the store; assistance requested to remove him.
Arrived at the response call; it was Motu, who had already left and crossed the road.
Standing by outside McDonald's Queen Street to ensure he does not return.
Heading back to continue charging the Ops Phone.
Standing by at HQ charging the Ops Phone.
Response call from McDonald's regarding a different group of vagrants/street people inside the store; assistance requested to move them along.
Arrived at the response call; staff advised they had already left around the corner near Timezone.
Attempted to track the individuals down; no sign of them in the area.
Standing by to show presence before moving along.
Leaving standby; patrolling up and down Queen Street awaiting response calls.
Welfare check at Timezone, ChaPanda, Chating, BBQ Chicken, all clear.
Welfare check at 77 Convenience Store Mid City, Avachi, Cue City, all clear.
Welfare check at Elliott Stables and the restaurants inside the premises.
Standing by at corner of Elliott Street and Wellesley Street West, all clear.
Welfare check at Te Waihorotiu train station, all clear.
Break completed; standing by for changeover to the Night Shift.

flags: MISSING SHIFT: Night — raw log ends at the 22:30 changeover entry; no Night Shift entries recorded for this date.
CAPACITY: 10:46 team re-tasked from the 10:38 aggressive-male response (individual not yet located) to intercept the second call; the first individual was never located.
